name: Legendary Warpriest Domains
body:
Where traditional warpriests select specific blessings associated with domains their deities provide, gaining major and minor abilities therefrom, the legendary warpriest offers much more versatility in being able to select blessings and their attendant special abilities from any of the domains their deity offers. A warpriest’s domains also determine their options for spontaneous spells that they may learn, as well as the options they may select with their sacred defense and avatar of war class features. Unless otherwise noted, the save DC for any blessing or other special ability derived from a warpriest’s domain is equal to 10 + 1/2 their warpriest level + their Wisdom modifier.

Domain Details
sss
Air Domain

A warpriest that follows this domain is swift like the wind and can wield the wind and lightning against their foes.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with the air or electricity descriptors, allows them to levitate or fly, or any spell that increases their speed.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—alter winds, 2nd—wind wall, 3rd—lightning bolt, 4th—air walk, 5th—control winds, 6th—chain lightning

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you gain electricity resistance 2 and a +2 bonus on saving throws against air effects and high winds.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you are surrounded by a vortex of winds. Any enemy that moves within 10 feet is either pushed away 10 feet or knocked prone (Reflex negates), your choice. In addition, any enemy that moves adjacent to you, or ends their turn adjacent to you takes electricity damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

BLESSINGS

Borne by the Winds (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 9th level

You can expend fervor as a standard action to grant yourself or a touched target the ability to fly as per the fly spell for 1 minute. The recipient also is treated as having ranks in the Fly skill equal to your legendary warpriest class level and this check is not penalized by winds.

Gusting Strikes (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to wreath your weapon with powerful winds for 1 minute. Once per round when striking an enemy with the affected weapon, you can make a free bull rush or trip combat maneuver using your Wisdom modifier instead of your normal ability modifier for the check. This combat maneuver does not provoke an attack of opportunity but does benefit from any ability or feat you possess that grants bonuses to those combat maneuvers. In addition to the combat maneuver, all strikes with the weapon deal 1 extra electricity damage per 4 caster levels you possess (minimum 1).

Stormborn (Ex)

You gain electricity resistance 5. At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this resistance increases by 5. As a swift action you may expend 1 fervor to gain immunity to electricity for 1 minute. This resistance stacks with the resistance provided by the sacred defense option.

Thunderbolt (Su)

You can call down lighting from the skies and direct it at your foes. As a standard action you can expend fervor to make a ranged touch attack against any creature within 60 feet If the bolt hits, it deals 1d6 points of electricity per 2 class levels. In addition to the damage, the target is staggered 1 round (Fort negates). If they fail the saving throw by 10 or more, they are dazed instead.

Wind’s Guidance (Su)

You can expend fervor as a swift action to gain the aid of the winds to make nearly impossible shots. For 1 minute you can ignore penalties on ranged attack rolls due to rain or wind. Also, once during the duration, when you miss with a ranged attack, you canyou’re your wind to redirect the attack toward another target within 20 feet of the original target, making a ranged attack as if they were the intended target.

Animal Domain

A warpriest with the animal domain brings the primal power of the beasts and other powerful fauna to bear on those who would do them harm.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with animals in the name, spells that target animals, summon animals or magical beasts or allow you to change form into animals or magical beasts. If you learn a spell that allows you to summon animals and other creatures, you may only use them to summon animals or magical beasts.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—cheetah’s sprint, 2nd—animal aspect, 3rd—greater animal aspect, 4th—aspect of the stag, 5th—aspect of the wolf, 6th—eagle aerie

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, you gain a +1 bonus to natural armor.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you become an apex predator, your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution increase by +4, and any spell you cast that changes your shape, summons animals or magical beasts can be quickened to a swift action using fervor regardless of their original casting time.

BLESSINGS

Bestial Fury (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to grant yourself or as a standard action on a touched ally to grant two 1d6 claw attacks or a 1d8 bite attack. These are primary natural attacks that replace the natural weapons possessed by the target if applicable. These damage dice are for Medium creatures, so adjust the dice for creatures larger or smaller than Medium.

These natural weapons last for 1 minute.

Bestial Grace (Ex)

You gain a +10 bonus to your base speed and a bonus to Acrobatics checks equal to 1/2 your level (minimum +1).

Feral Senses (Ex)

You gain a bonus to Perception checks equal to 1/2 your class level and low-light vision. At 4th level you gain darkvision out to 60 feet and scent. At 8th level, your darkvision extends to 120 feet.

Wild Calling (Sp)

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to cast summon nature’s ally I, however you can only summon a single animal or magical beast. At 3rd level and every two levels thereafter the spell level increases by 1 (to a maximum of summon nature’s ally IX at 17th level. Regardless of the spell level, you may still only summon a single animal or magical beast. The duration for this spell is 1 minute rather than the normal duration of the spell.

Wild Shape (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 5th level

You can expend a use of fervor to wild shape like a druid for 1 hour. You may only choose animals or magical beasts, but otherwise to determine the power or available options of the wild shape, you are considered a druid of your class level – 2.

Artifice Domain

A warpriest with the artifice domain creates and employs the tools of war against their enemies. Their hard work and ingenuity can surmount the power of many of their enemies.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with the creation subschool, or spells that hide, reveal, find, control, move, modify, repair, improve, or damage objects, constructs or items. This includes spells that animate objects or transform you into a construct.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—crafter’s fortune, 2nd—wood shape, 3rd—stone shape, 4th—minor creation, 5th—fabricate, 6th—major creation

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you gain +1 AC if you are wearing armor or wielding a shield you have created. You only get this bonus once even if you are wearing multiple armors/shields you have created.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, your body becomes an object of rare materials. The exact nature of the materials depends on the relationship you have with your deity or faith and the objects you favor. For example, your body could become built out of gleaming mithral and gilded in gold, or you could be made from shining obsidian or hard ironwood. Regardless, you are treated as a construct for the purposes of spells and abilities that affect a creature type like favored enemy and dominate person, or spells or abilities that only target living creatures. In addition, you gain a DR 10/-, 20 temporary hp and a 50% fortification and a 1d8 slam attack (for medium creatures, adjust the damage if you are larger or smaller). The slam attack gained qualifies for the weapons of faithful ability or the sacred weapon blessing. You are still able to be healed by spells that would normally heal you and mind-affecting effects.

BLESSINGS

Artificer’s Touch (Sp)

You can cast mending at will, using your class level as the caster level. In addition, you can spend fervor as a standard action to deal damage to an object or construct with a melee touch attack. The damage dealt is equal to 1d6 per 2 class levels you possess. This damage is considered magical and is not subject to hardness or damage reduction. However, if the target is immune to magic, this ability is still effective.

Borne by Faith (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 9th level

You can expend fervor as a swift action to infuse a weapon you created with the power of your deity or faith. For 1 minute, the weapon is treated as having the dancing special weapon quality. This ability does not count as a special ability for the weapon for the purposes of its maximum total enhancement bonus. You can only have one weapon active with this ability or an innate dancing ability at a time.

Engineering Mastery (Ex)

You gain a bonus on Craft and Knowledge (engineering) checks equal to 1/2 your class level. In addition, you can expend fervor as a swift action to gain the ability to bypass a construct or object’s hardness or damage reduction for 1 minute.

Servants of the Faith (Sp)

Prerequisites: 7th level

You can expend fervor as a standard action to produce the effects of animate objects as a cleric equal to your class level.

Weapon of Faith (Su)

While wielding a weapon you created or one for which you have taken at least 1 hour to hone and improve, you may choose between the base damage of the weapon or the damage listed in the table below based on your level. The damages below are based upon a Medium creature. Adjust the dice for your size.

Additionally, you may expend a use of fervor as a swift action to enhance the weapon wielded for 1 minute. The weapon is treated as masterwork at 1st level. At 4th level, this increases to a +1 enhancement. Every 4 levels thereafter, the enhancement bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +5). This enhancement bonus is in addition to any bonus possessed by the weapon, though the total bonus still cannot exceed +10. You may choose weapon special abilities if the weapon already has a +1 enhancement bonus either by the blessing or innately.

Chaos Domain

A warpriest with the chaos domain are change-makers and move with and promote everchanging battlefields.

Spells Available to Learn: All spells with the chaos descriptor, cause confusion, or colorful patterns. If you gain a spell that gains a descriptor based upon its usage, like summon monster, you can only use the version that grants the chaos descriptor.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—protection from law, 2nd—hideous laughter, 3rd—magic circle against law, 4th—chaos hammer, 5th—dispel law, 6th—cloak of dreams

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC and saves against lawful creatures.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you gain DR 10/chaos and any creature you hit with a weapon is confused 1d6 rounds (Will negates). If a target fails another save while already confused, roll 1d6 to determine the new duration, using the new duration if longer than the original duration, but the duration does not stack. A creature immune to mind-affecting effects is instead dazed for 1 round on a failed save.

Level	Damage
1st-4th	1d6
5th-9th	1d8
10th-14th	1d10
15th-19th	2d6
20th	2d8

BLESSINGS

Aura of Chaos (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 9th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to exude a 30-foot aura of wild energy for 1 minute. All enemies within the aura must declare one type of action at the start of their turn (attack, cast a spell, move, use an item, or activate a special ability) and make a Will save; if failed, they must take an action other than their declared action and cannot take the declared action until the beginning of their next turn. If they succeed, they must take the declared action. Creatures cannot select actions that they cannot perform.

Born of Chaos (Su)

You may use fervor as an immediate action on your turn to either act normally while confused or be subject to the confused condition instead of being affected by a mindaffecting effect that would force actions against your will.

You cannot do both simultaneously. This benefit lasts for the lesser of the underlying effect or 1 minute.

Touch of Confusion (Sp)

As a standard action, you may expend fervor to touch a creature and scramble their perceptions, causing them to become confused for a number of rounds equal to your warpriest level (Will negates). The target gets a new save each round at the end of its turn to end the effect. This is not a mind-affecting effect and affects mindless creatures.

Random Result (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 7th level

As an immediate action, you can expend a use of fervor to cause a creature within 30 feet to reroll a dice, or set of dice and must take the second result. For example, you could make a creature reroll an attack roll or a wizard reroll the damage dice from a fireball.

Weapon of Chaos (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to cause your weapon to shine with scintillating colors, shedding light as a torch in constantly changing colors for 1 minute.

Your weapon is considered chaotic for overcoming damage reduction and targets struck are dazzled for 1 round. If the target does not have eyes or is blinded, they are immune to the dazzling.

Charm Domain

A warpriest with the charm domain can be diplomats or seducers, though all have powers to vex the mind and assume a friendly face.

Spells Available to Learn: All spells which grant a bonus to Charisma or a bonus to a Charisma-based skill, spells which transform you into a fey, spells that affect a creature’s attitude, and illusion spells with a range of personal.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—charm person, 2nd—calm emotions, 3rd—charm person, 4th—befuddled combatant, 5th—dominate person, 6th—foe to friend

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, if you do not attack another creature on your turn, you gain the benefits of a sanctuary spell with a caster level equal to your warpriest level, the save DC to overcome this sanctuary is 11 + 1/2 your warpriest level + the number of times you have chosen this sacred defense. While under the effects of this sanctuary you may choose to end its effect to increase the save DC of the next non damaging spell you cast by the number of times you have chosen this sacred defense. If you do, you take an equal penalty to armor class until the beginning of your next turn and cannot reform the sanctuary for 10 minutes.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you become a being of beauty and awe. You can blind creatures that look upon you and deafen creatures that hear your voice. You gain a 30-foot aura, any enemy who enters or begins their turn inside this aura must make a Fortitude save equal to 20 + your Charisma modifier or be permanently rendered blind and deaf.

BLESSINGS

Benefit of the Doubt (Su)

Your words are nearly always taken in the best possible light. Once per round, when you roll a Charisma-based skill check you may spend fervor to roll twice and take the better result.

Combat Charmer (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You can turn even the most violent foe’s mind to consider your words. You may spend fervor to make a Diplomacy check as a full-round action in combat against one creature that can see and hear you. The DC of this check is equal to the DC to improve the creature’s attitude plus 10.

If successful, the creature sincerely considers your words and is staggered until your next turn. The following turn, you may make another Diplomacy check as a standard action against the same creature as in the previous round and, if you succeed, they are stunned until the beginning of your next turn. If the creature is unharmed for both rounds while under the effects of this ability you may make a third check as a free action at the beginning of your turn, if successful the creature will exit combat and leave the area. When you next encounter the creature you gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks to improve its attitude and it treats you as indifferent unless you or your companions threaten or harm them. The creature targeted must be able to see you and you must share a language, unless the creature has an Intelligence less than 3.

Diplomatic Immunity (Ex)

Your civil acumen has benefits beyond diplomacy. You gain a bonus on saving throws against all mind-affecting effects equal to your Charisma modifier and you may spend fervor as an immediate action to add your Charisma modifier to AC against a single ranged attack. In addition, the DC to affect you with Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate (such as using Bluff to create a distraction or Intimidate to demoralize) increases by 10.

Familiar Face (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

You can seem to take on the appearance and personality of someone trusted. You may spend fervor as a swift action and choose a creature within 100 feet that you can see. That creature must attempt a Will save (DC of 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier). If the save fails, you gain knowledge of a living person they trust and may change your appearance to match them. While so disguised you gain a bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks when interacting with creatures who would trust your appearance equal to 1/2 your class level, rounded down. In addition, you gain enough information about the creature you change into sufficient to answer questions about the impersonated creature’s life to satisfy the target’s curiosity and allay their suspicions. This is an illusion (glamer) effect and divination effect.

Ties That Bind (Su)

You know that a close relationship has its advantages. Whenever you cast a spell which targets a creature whose attitude towards you is friendly or better, treat your caster level as one higher when determining that spell’s effects.

You may spend fervor as part of casting the spell to either treat your caster level as two higher instead or increase the saved DC by +1.

Community Domain

A warpriest with the community domain is a protector and steward of communities, big and small.

Spells Available to Learn: All non-personal spells which provide a bonus to or grant new senses or any spell with communal in its name as well as their non-communal variants.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—mage armor, 2nd—shield other, 3rd—communal darkvision, 4th—telepathic bond, 5th—battlemind link, 6th—animate objects

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, when activated it provides a +1 sacred bonus to the AC of adjacent allies.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you may cast a spell with communal in its name as a swift action and target all allies within 30 ft even if the spell normally requires you to touch the targets. In addition these allies benefit from your sacred defense as though they were adjacent to you.

BLESSINGS

Bar the Gate (Su)

You can keep your community safe from any threat.

Whenever you deal damage to a creature, you can prevent it from moving past you (Will negates) for 10 minutes. You must choose one direction in which the creature cannot move past your location. The effect ends if you become unconscious, helpless, or dead, and the effect applies only within 30 feet of you (60 feet if you are 10th level or higher).

After 10 minutes, an affected creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

Communal Expansion (Su)

Prerequisite: 11th level

Your bond with others allows you to, when you cast a spell with communal in its name you may expend a use of fervor as part of the action to cast the spell to double the available duration before dividing it amongst targets.

Community Watch (Su)

Your faith uses the many perspectives around you to keep your community safe. Sleeping creatures within 30 feet of you suffer no penalties on perception checks. This ability applies to yourself and nearby creatures even while you are sleeping or unconscious.

Friends in Every Town (Ex)

You can make friends wherever people gather. You may add your Wisdom bonus as well as your Charisma bonus to Diplomacy checks. You may expend a use of fervor to reduce the time needed to influence a creature’s attitude or make a request to one full round.

Hearth and Home (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

You can always return to a safe place. When you rest in a location where you have a friendly relationship with multiple residents you heal at twice the normal rate. In addition, you may expend a use of fervor to teleport yourself and up to 1 ally per 3 class levels within 30 ft to such a location you rested at in the last 24 hours.

Darkness Domain

A warpriest with the darkness domain is borne of darkness and revels in the power of shadow. Darkness is a tool with which to bind your foes.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with the darkness or shadow descriptors, provide the ability to see in darkness or blind a target.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—shadow trap, 2nd—darkness, 3rd—deeper darkness, 4th—shadow conjuration, 5th—shadow evocation, 6th—shadow transmutation

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, you gain a 5% miss chance due to concealment when in an area of dim light or darker, even if the creature has low-light vision or darkvision. This bonus stacks with the concealment provided by dark conditions if applicable. This ability has no effect on creatures that do not rely on sight.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you blur the lines between your current plane and shadow plane around you. Any attacks or spells that target you or a creature within 10 feet of you are considered quasi-real. A target that succeeds on a Will save takes half damage from the attack, ability, or spell. This ability has no effect in an area of bright light. Additionally, you can cast any spell with the darkness or shadow descriptor as a swift action regardless of target by expending fervor.

BLESSINGS

Darkened Vision (Sp)

Prerequisites: 7th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to temporarily blind a foe with a shard of the Shadow Plane for 1 round (Will negates). At 13th level, this blinding effect also prevents blindsense and blindsight.

Empowered Darkness (Su)

You can empower any darkness or shadow descriptor effect you create that lowers a light level by expending a use of fervor as a free action. For the duration of the effect, even creatures with darkvision are unable to see through the darkness effect. You can designate up to 1 creature per 4 class levels (minimum 1), including yourself, to be able to see through the darkness as normal.

At 14th level, this also prevents creatures with the see in darkness ability from seeing through the darkness.

Eyes of Night (Ex)

You gain the see in darkness universal monster ability.

Shadow Empowerment (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 5th level

Anytime you cast a spell with the shadow descriptor that produces a quasi-real effect, you increase the % of damage or effect by 5% per 5 class levels you possess (to a maximum of 20% at 20th level. The percentage cannot exceed 100%.

Shadow Step (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a move-equivalent action to jump from one shadow to another. The areas must be dim lighting or darker and you can only travel 10 feet per class level.

Death Domain

A warpriest with the death domain bears to power of death and undeath creating more fodder with which to build their army.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with the death descriptor, any spell that emulates death or undeath, or spells that summon or create undead.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—ray of enfeeblement, 2nd—death knell, 3rd—animate dead, 4th—enervation, 5th—slay living, 6th—create undead

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, you gain a +1 channel resistance and a +1 bonus to saves against poison and disease.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you are always healed by negative energy, immunity to death effects, have DR 10/silver and can quicken spells with the death descriptor using fervor even if they do not target you.

BLESSINGS

Blessing of Undeath (Su)

As a standard action, you can expend a use of fervor to touch a willing creature, including yourself, and grant them some protections and powers of undeath. For one minute, the target gains a bonus equal to your legendary warpriest class level to Disguise checks to pose as dead or undead. They also gain a profane bonus equal to 1/4 your class level on saving throws against disease, poison and death effects and on Intimidate checks. Finally, they are healed by negative energy and harmed by positive energy.

Enervating Touch (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

As a standard action that expends a use of fervor and touch a target to inflict 1 temporary negative level. Alternatively, you can deliver the negative level with a swift action through a melee attack. This temporary negative level lasts for 1 minute, and stacks with other temporary negative levels imposed by this ability. Each additional temporary negative level resets the duration for all temporary negative levels. You cannot use this ability to heal or grant temporary hit points to undead.

Hasten Death (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

Your weapons are imbued with negative energy to hasten a target’s path to the afterlife. Upon confirming a critical hit with a melee or ranged attack, you can expend a use of fervor to cause the target to take negative energy damage equal to 1/2 your class level each round at the beginning of your turn until they are healed by a conjuration (healing) spell; they also may end the effect with a successful Fortitude save each round at the end of their turn. If the target is immune to or is healed by negative energy, this has no effect.

Lingering Wounds (Su)

When dealing damage to a target, you can expend fervor as a swift action to cause the damage to be more difficult to heal. The damage will not heal normally, The DC for any Heal check is increased by 1/2 your class level and any spell that heals hit point damage must first pass a caster level check equal to 10 + your class level + your Wisdom modifier before it can heal that damage.

Negative Energy Mastery (Ex)

Prerequisite: 3rd level

When using fervor to channel negative energy, increase the dice to 1d6 per 2 class levels you possess instead of four levels you possess after 2nd.

Destruction Domain

A warpriest with the destruction domain provided is a storm of destructive power in the name of their faith, reducing their enemies to ruins.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells that deal elemental damage, physical damage, increase your Strength, or destroy objects.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—hairline fractures, 2nd—shatter, 3rd—raging rubble, 4th—detonate, 5th—rune of ruin, 6th—disintegrate

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, you gain a +2 bonus against sunder attempts and any items worn or wielded gain a +2 bonus to their hardness.

Avatar of War: When activating sacred defense, you deal 1d6 damage to all creatures and objects within 20 feet. The damage increases to 2d6 within 10 feet and 3d6 within 5 feet. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage for the round. The damage is considered magical bludgeoning damage and is subject to DR and hardness. You can spend fervor to exclude any number of objects and creatures from this effect for 2d4 rounds.

BLESSINGS

Destructive Aura (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

As a standard action that expends a use of fervor you can exude a 30-foot aura of enhanced destruction for 1 minute.

All damage dealt, including to yourself or your allies, within the aura is increased by 1/2 your class level and all critical threats are automatically confirmed. This bonus to damage does not stack with the damage bonus from destructive power.

Destructive Power (Su)

As long as you have at least 1 fervor remaining, you increase the damage of any attack or spell by 1 per 4 class levels (minimum 1).

Catastrophic Storm (Sp)

Prerequisite: 9th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to conjure a powerful storm. For 1 minute, the storm covers a radius around you equal to 5 feet per class level. Each round at the beginning of your turn or when the storm is activated, the storm has one of the following effects chosen by you: driving rain (–4 on all Perception checks and ranged attack rolls), howling winds (–8 on Fly skill checks and ranged attack rolls), heavy snow (all terrain is considered difficult), or a lightning bolt (as call lightning, coming down on a square of your choice within range without requiring an action). Other effects depending on the weather might also apply (at the GM’s discretion). No effect may be repeated on the following round.

Educated Destruction (Ex)

You gain a bonus on Knowledge (engineering) checks equal to 1/2 your class level. In addition, you can expend fervor as a swift action to gain the ability to bypass a construct or object’s hardness or damage reduction for 1 minute.

Mutual Destruction (Ex)

You can expend a use of fervor as an immediate action when taking damage to deal 1/2 of the damage taken back upon the source of the damage. If the original effect allowed for a save, the source of the damage is allowed the same save to reduce this reflected damage.

Disease Domain

The most well-known deity who grants the disease domain to her followers is the Princess of Pestilence, but other deities who revel in undeath and corruption may also grant these powers. A legendary cleric with the disease domain sees the spread of plague and affliction as her divine duty, and actively cultivates these ailments in her own person. To her, transmission of a disease is a gift, and succumbing to that disease is a holy death.

Granted Powers: Gruesome boils and pustules erupt from your skin and spray foes with a sickening liquid. You spread disease wherever you go but do not perish from the effects.

Nauseating Bolt (Sp)

As a standard action, you burst one of your many pustules and unleash a bolt of pus. You can target any single foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack with this bolt. It you hit the foe, the target is nauseated for 1 round and sickened an additional round for every two cleric levels you possess. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Carrier (Su)

Your ability scores can never drop below 1 as a result of a disease. At 4th level, you can be infected by a disease without suffering any ill effects. At 8th level you can choose to spread a disease you are currently carrying as a melee touch attack. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 your cleric level.

This ability otherwise functions as contagion.

Domain Spells: 1st—ray of sickening, 2nd—ghoul touch; 3rd—contagion, 4th—plague carrier, 5th—greater contagion, 6th—epidemic, 7th—plague storm, 8th—horrid wilting; 9th—cursed earth.

Earth Domain

A warpriest with the earth domain is solid like the mountains and violent like an earthquake. They crush their enemies and bury them deep in the earth.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with the earth and descriptors or spells with metals, stone or earth in the name of the spell like stoneskin.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—magic stone, 2nd—stone call, 3rd—stone shape, 4th—spike stones, 5th—wall of stone, 6th—stoneskin

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you gain DR 1/bludgeoning, and a +1 bonus on saving throws against acid effects.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, your body turns into metal and stone. You gain a +8 natural armor bonus and a slam attack that deals 1d8 damage and is considered adamantine for DR purposes. In addition, you can cast any spell with the earth descriptor as a swift action by using fervor regardless of the target.

BLESSINGS

Acid Breath (Su)

You can expend fervor to spray out a gout of acid in a 30-foot line as a standard action. Each creature in the line takes 1d6 acid damage per two warpriest levels you possess (Reflex half ). A creature damaged by this acid breath is also sickened 1 round “Fort negates.”

Born of the Earth (Ex)

You gain acid resistance 5. At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this resistance increases by 5. As a swift action you may expend 1 fervor to gain immunity to acid for 1 minute.

Earth Stride (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 3rd level

You can expend fervor as a standard action to grant yourself the ability to move across any stone surface as if affected by the spider climb spell for 10 minutes. At 13th level, you gain the effects of earth glide as well for the duration.

Earthen Roots (Sp)

You can expend fervor as a standard action to bind a creature with dirt and stone. This acts as the spell entangle (Reflex partial; as the spell) except it transmutes and animates dirt and stone instead of plants and only affects one creature. The effect continues to impact the target for 1 minute and they must make a saving throw each round.

If they fail on a second saving throw they are grappled, and a third they are pinned. If they ever succeed, the condition is lessened or removed for the round.

Mineral Transmutation (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to change the composition and material of a stone, gemstone, or metal object for 1 minute. You can change the object to a kind of mundane stone, steel, cold iron or silver. At 5th level, the item can be transformed into gold, gemstones, hard stones, or mithral. At 9th level, you can change the object to adamantine.

Evil Domain

Creatures succeeding on this saving throw take a -1 penalty to attack rolls and AC until the start of your next turn, as they are still thrown off balance by your overwhelming presence. A creature can only be affected by this ability once every 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect.

Bow to No One (Su)

Your will is so strong even monarchs and generals cannot command you to bow. You add your Charisma modifier on Will saves and to your combat maneuver defense to avoid being tripped, dragged, or repositioned.

Crown of Valor (Su)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You manifest a glowing crown in battle, calling attention to yourself and emboldening allies. When you roll initiative, you may spend fervor to have a shimmering crown appear upon your brow, shedding light in a 30 ft radius granting allies in its area a +2 morale bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against fear. While the crown is active you take a -2 penalty to AC. This crown dissipates if you are knocked unconscious or you drop out of initiative.

Noble Posturing (Ex)

You carry yourself well in social situations. You add +1/2 your class level on all Diplomacy checks. If you are at a social gathering, meeting, or negotiation where status would be relevant you also gain this bonus on Intimidate checks against creatures of lower social status than yourself who are also in attendance.

Born Leader (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You have understood how to give orders and bear responsibility from a young age. You gain Leadership as a bonus feat. If you already possess Leadership as a feat or gain it later, instead increase your leadership score by 2.

Note: In campaigns where Leadership is unavailable, Born Leader provides the following benefit instead: You gain a bonus equal to 1/2 your character level to Diplomacy checks and to the DC a creature must succeed at to demoralize you.

Plant Domain

A warpriest with the plant domain is an avatar of natural vengeance, pushing back on the ravages of other creatures of the flora of the world.

Spells Available to Learn: Any spells that mention plants, empower plants and specifically affect plants.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—entangle, 2nd—barkskin, 3rd—plant growth, 4th—command plants, 5th—wall of thorns, 6th—repel wood

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you add a +1 natural armor bonus.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you are considered to be a plant creature for detrimental spells, enemies do not gain concealment from you due to plants. Plant spells, like entangle, will not affect you unless you allow them to. Additionally, you may cast any spell on a plant creature as a swift action without expending fervor.

BLESSINGS

Bramble Armor (Su)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to grow thorns from your body. Any creature attacking you in melee while adjacent or with a melee natural weapon regardless of range, take 1d6 magical piercing damage + 1/2 your legendary warpriest level. This armor lasts for 1 minute.

Creeping Vines (Su)

Once per round as a free action, you can entangle a creature you have hit with a melee attack for 1 round (Reflex negates).

Plant Growth (Sp)

By expending a use of fervor as swift action, you can grant the effects of enlarge person on yourself, though the change in size is totally made up of plant life, for 1 minute. You can also use this ability on a plant creature, granting it the effects of the spell even though they normally would not qualify.

Plant Step (Sp)

Prerequisites: 9th level

As a standard action, you can expend a point of fervor to gain the effects of dimension door as long as the beginning and ending points have plant life in the square. The caster level of the dimension door is equal to your class level.

Wooden Strikes (Su)

As a free action, you can expend fervor to gain 2 slam natural attacks that deal 1d6 damage (for a medium creature). The fists are festooned with thorns so the damage is both bludgeoning and piercing. If you wield a weapon and one hand is free, you can make a slam attack as a secondary natural attack alongside your weapon attacks. At 5th level, the damage is considered silver and cold iron for DR purposes. At 7th level, the damage type is also considered magic. At 11th level the damage is considered adamantine for DR purposes. These slam attacks last for 1 minute.

Protection Domain

A warpriest with the protection domain is a living shield for their allies on the battlefield.

Their prime offense is a blessed defense.

Spells Available to Learn: Any spells that grant a resistance against damage, increased saves, increased AC, spell resistance, prevents attacks, deflects spells, or damage reduction.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—sanctuary, 2nd—shield other, 3rd—protection from energy, 4th—spell immunity, 5th—spell resistance, 6th—globe of invulnerability

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you add a +1 deflection bonus to your AC.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you gain DR 5/- and as a swift action on your turn you can transfer any beneficial spell you cast upon yourself to an ally. Additionally, you can use fervor to quicken the casting of any spell that grants a bonus to AC or saves, resistance to damage or damage reduction regardless of target. If you are the only target, this does not cost a use of fervor.

BLESSINGS

Aura of Elemental Resistance (Su)

Prerequisite: 11th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to project a 30-foot aura for 1 minute. You and each ally within the aura gain a resistance of 10 against all energy damage. At 15th level, this increases to a resistance of 20.

Conjure Fortification (Sp)

By expending a use of fervor as standard action, you can summon a small wall of force to grant cover to a medium or smaller creature in the square from 1 direction. This fortification lasts for 1 minute. The aesthetics of the wall depends largely on the faith or deity granting you the power. You can have 1 simultaneous fortification equal to 1 + 1 per 5 class levels you possess. Two adjacent fortifications can grant cover for a Large creature, 4 for a Huge creature, 8 for a Gargantuan creature, and 16 for a Colossal creature. The fortification of force is translucent and cannot be used to grant Stealth, but it can interrupt attacks of opportunity.

Defensive Stance (Ex)

Prerequisites: 7th level

As a swift action, you can expend a point of fervor to enter a defensive stance for 1 minute. While the stance is active you gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC, temporary hit points equal to twice your class level, and +2 resistance bonus to Fortitude and Will saves. Additionally, any creature adjacent to you that is your size or smaller gains improved cover to attacks or effects originating from the opposite side of you, use a cone template for this purpose. You temporarily lose the bonuses, granted cover and temporary hit points if you move more than 5 feet during the round, regaining them at the beginning of the following turn.

Empowered Defense (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to gain a +2 sacred bonus to AC and saves for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 at 10th level and +4 at 20th level. Anytime during the duration, you can grant the bonus to a touched target as a swift action, losing your own bonus. As long as the minute has not elapsed, you can take the bonus back as a swift action touch of the target.

Move to the Defense (Ex)

As an immediate action, you can expend fervor, when an ally is targeted with an attack roll, to move up to your base speed toward them. This movement does not count against your movement during your turn. If you end up adjacent to the ally you can interpose yourself in the path of the attack.

The attack then is treated as targeting you instead and the attack is compared to your AC and other protections.

Repose Domain

A warpriest with the repose domain is someone who performs funerary rites, ensures last wishes are fulfilled and opposes undead.

Spells Available to Learn: All spells which have a special effect against undead, spells which target only undead, and spells that protect creatures from negative energy.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—deathwatch, 2nd—gentle repose, 3rd—speak with dead, 4th—death ward, 5th—antilife shell, 6th—undeath to death

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, when activated it grants you a +1 bonus to AC and saves against the attacks of undead and effects which deal negative energy damage or apply energy drain.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, all weapons you carry gains the disruption magic weapon property. In addition when you activate your sacred defense you let loose a burst of positive energy healing all allies within 30 feet of you for 4d8 + 20 and dealing damage to all undead in the same area for the same amount.

BLESSINGS

Bless the Body (Su)

You can stave off not just the curse of undeath but other ailments as well. You may spend fervor as a swift action to grant an adjacent creature, or yourself, a new save against a poison, disease, or curse effect. When you do the creature gains a bonus on the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier.

Eternal Rest (Su)

When a creature dies, it should stay dead. Whenever a creature dies within 30 feet of you that creature can’t be raised as undead for at least one year. In addition, you may perform a ritual on any corpse, costing 25 gp in supplies per HD of the corpse and taking 10 minutes to bless it in such a way that it can never be raised as an undead unless it is reinterred on desecrated ground.

Positive Influence (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

Your soul is a wellspring of life, suppressing or diffusing negative energy. Whenever you would be in the area of channeled negative energy its effectiveness is reduced by a number of dice equal to 1/2 your class level, rounded down.

For example, if you are level 9 and within the area of an evil cleric’s channeled negative energy for 6d6 they would only roll 2d6 for damage. In addition, you may spend two uses of fervor as a standard action to replace a desecrate spell with a consecrate spell or you may spend three fervor as a full-round action to hallow an area as the spell, though with a duration of only 24 hours. During that time, you may spend the necessary material components normally used for the spell and 8 hours in prayer or meditation to give the effect its full normal duration.

Scourge of the Dead (Su)

You are an enemy of the undead as well as those who cause them to rise. You may spend fervor as a swift action to gain a bonus on attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier and a bonus on damage rolls equal to your class level for 1 minute when attacking creatures of the undead type, creatures that have necromancy spells known or prepared, and creatures that have a spell-like ability of a necromancy spell.

Sleep Like the Dead (Su)

Prerequisite: 5th level

You can impose rest upon others if needed. You may spend fervor and make a touch attack as a standard action. If the attack hits, the target fall unconscious for 1 hour (Will negates). Use your Charisma modifier to determine the save DC. The creature can be woken with some effort but not from noise less than a loud speaking volume or a slight nudge. The effort needed to wake the creature is significant enough that it requires at least a standard action. This ability functions on undead and other creatures normally unable to be rendered unconscious but does not function against constructs.

Rune Domain

A warpriest with the rune domain brings the power of words and symbols to bear upon their enemies.

Spells Available to Learn: Any spell that creates a symbol, sigil, glyph, rune, or word, or spell that allows you to interpret, understand or speak a language.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—incendiary runesPPC:BM, 2nd—fiery runesPPC:MTT, 3rd—glyph of warding, 4th—explosive runes, 5th—symbol of striking, 6th—greater glyph of warding

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you add a +1 sacred bonus to saves against spells or effects with verbal components, language-dependent effects and spells or effects relying on written words, rune, glyphs, sigils or symbols.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you can expend fervor to cast any rune, sigil, symbol or glyph spell as a 1 round casting time if the normal casting time is 1 minute or more. If the casting time is 1 round or less, you can expend fervor to cast it as a swift action. You do not trigger rune, glyph, sigil or symbol spells unless you choose to and you gain a +5 deflection bonus to AC.

BLESSINGS

Blast Rune (Sp)

As a standard action you can expend fervor to create a blast rune in any adjacent square. Any creature that enters the rune’s space triggers the rune and takes 1d6 damage per 2 class levels you possess. The damage type can be acid, cold, electricity or fire, chosen when the spell is cast, though you can expend an additional point of fervor for the rune to deal force or sonic damage instead. The rune is invisible but can be seen with a true seeing spell and lasts for 1 minute or until discharged. You can’t create a blast rune in a square already occupied by a creature.

You may specify a number of creatures equal to your class level (including yourself ) that are not impacted by these runes. The rune is considered to have a spell level equal to 1/2 your class level (maximum 9th) for the purposes of dispelling and the DC to discover the rune with Perception and disable the rune with Disable Device is 25 plus the effective spell level of the rune.

Runic Spell (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

You can expend a use of fervor when casting a spell to create a runic version of the spell. For triggering and placement purposes, this runic spell uses the same rules as the spell symbol of death but when triggered, the spell is activated.

Spell-Storing Weapon (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 11th level

You can expend a use of fervor to store a spell in a held weapon as if it had the spell storing weapon special ability.

The stored spell remains in the weapon for 1 hour, until it is used, or the weapon leaves your possession.

Warding Rune (Sp)

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to create a rune that keeps creatures from entering the space within 30 feet. You can create a number of these warded spaces equal to 1/2 your class level. You can only have that maximum number of warded squares active simultaneously regardless of the number of times you use this ability.

The runes are active when placed and last for 10 minutes.

Any creature attempting to enter a space is blocked by the power of the rune and unable to enter the space “Will negates,” though they can try again on their next turn. The saving throw is per instance of crossing an affected space.

For example, if you cross two consecutive squares of the runes, you roll the saving throw twice.

You may specify a number of creatures equal to your class level “including yourself ” that are not impacted by these runes. The rune is considered to have a spell level equal to 1/2 your class level (maximum 9th) for the purposes of dispelling and the DC to discover the rune with Perception and disable the rune with Disable Device is 25 plus the effective spell level of the rune.

Self-Inscribed Rune (Ex)

You can place any rune, symbol, sigil, or glyph spell on yourself, your armor, or your shield without needing to expend fervor. This includes the runes derived from the rune domain abilities. The spell or effect triggers as normal for the effect or it can be triggered by you as an immediate action when attacked or as a standard action on your turn. In the latter two circumstances, the effect of the triggered rune is centered on an adjacent square of your choosing. In all cases, you are exempted from the effects. You cannot force trigger the warding rune as it is constantly active for the duration, but it can prevent tiny creatures and swarms from entering your space.

Scalykind Domain

A warpriest with the scalykind domain is a friend, protector, or master of reptilian and draconic life.

Spells Available to Learn: All transmutation spells that allow transformation into a reptilian or draconic creature as well as spells that grant new natural attacks.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—magic fang, 2nd—greater magic fang, 3rd—draconic reservoir, 4th—dragon’s breath, 5th—fire snake, 6th—form of the dragon I

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, increase your natural armor bonus by +1.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, choose a type of chromatic or metallic dragon. you gain immunity to the same energy type as that dragon and gain the breath weapon of its adult age category.

BLESSINGS

Draconic Bearing (Su)

Prerequisite: 11th level

You strive to emulate the most powerful and awe-inspiring of scalykind. You gain the ability to mimic the frightful presence of true dragons. As a free action, you can release an aura of fear, each enemy within 30 feet is shaken for 2d4 rounds (Will negates); use your Charisma modifier to determine the save DC. When a creature fails this save, you may spend one use of fervor as a free action to increase the duration for that creature to 1 minute. Once a creature successfully saves against this aura, they are immune to it for 24 hours.

Draconic Wings (Ex)

You grow closer to the majesty of dragons gaining wings.

Initially, these wings are vestigial, granting a +2 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump and reducing falling damage as if any fall was 30 feet shorter. You may spend one use of fervor to gain a fly speed (with poor maneuverability) equal to your land speed for 1 round.

When you reach 10th level you gain a fly speed with average maneuverability equal to your base land speed and you may spend one use of fervor to increase this fly speed by 20 feet for 1 minute.

Elemental Affinity (Su)

You have respect for the natural forces often employed by dragons and other scaly creatures. You may add 10 spell levels worth of spells with the acid, cold, fire, or electricity descriptors from among the druid and sorcerer/wizard spell lists to your spell list. You may not choose spells whose level is greater than 6th and cannot cast spells for which you do not yet possess the proper spell slots.

Scaly Companion (Ex)

Prerequisite: 3rd level

Your bond with scaly creatures manifests as a link to a specific creature. You gain an animal companion as a druid of your warpriest level -4, but you must choose a reptilian or dinosaur creature.

Saurian Weaponry (Ex)

Your form changes when you gain this blessing, granting you saurian features and natural weapons. Choose either bite, claws, or tail. You gain a natural attack of the type chosen. If you choose bite, it is a primary natural weapon that deals 1d6 and you add one and a half times your strength modifier to its damage rolls. If you choose claws you gain two primary claw attacks which deal 1d4 damage, and if you choose tail you gain a tail as a secondary natural weapon that deals 1d10 damage. These values are for a medium creature. You can gain this blessing more than once, but you must choose a different natural weapon each time.

Strength Domain

A warpriest with the strength domain is granted immense power with which to overpower and crush their foes.

Spells Available to Learn: All spells that increase your physical attributes or size, grant you damage reduction or resistance to damage, or your form into a stronger form.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—enlarge person, 2nd—bull’s strength, 3rd—monstrous physique I, 4th—divine power, 5th—righteous might, 6th—stoneskin

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you gain DR 1/adamantine.

Avatar of War: While your sacred defense is active, your speed and skills are not impeded by your armor or load, your base attack bonus is equivalent to a fighter of your same level and spells that increase your Strength score do not require fervor to cast as a swift action upon yourself.

BLESSINGS

Combat Ferocity (Su)

As an immediate action when dealing damage with a melee attack that uses your Strength modifier to hit and for damage, you can expend a fervor to increase the damage dealt by 1.5x your warpriest class level.

Compensation Training (Ex)

Prerequisite: 5th level

You can use weapons one size category larger than you can normally use without incurring any penalty or change in handedness.

Resolve (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

You can grant your strength of resolve to nearby allies. You can expend two uses of fervor as a standard action to grant all allies within 20 feet temporary hit points equal to your legendary warpriest class level plus your Wisdom modifier.

The temporary hit points remain for 1 round per class level.

Second Wind (Su)

As a standard action, you can expend one use of fervor to touch a target and remove fatigue, reduce exhaustion to fatigue, or heal 1d3 Strength damage. You can do so as a swift action on yourself. At 8th level, you can instead remove exhaustion or heal 1d4 Strength damage or 1 Strength drain.

Strength Surge (Su)

As a swift action, you can expend a use of fervor to grant yourself an enhancement bonus to Strength-based d20 rolls and damage rolls equal to 1/2 your class level for 1 round.

You can also halve your armor check penalty and ignore the speed penalty from your load or armor during that time.

Sun Domain

A warpriest that follows this domain brings burning light in hand to burn away the darkness.

Spells Available to Learn: All spells with the light or fire descriptors or any spell that has sun in the name.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—flare burst, 2nd—fury of the sun, 3rd— searing light, 4th—shield of dawn, 5th—flame strike, 6th—greater shield of dawn

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense you gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against spells with the darkness or shadow descriptors and on AC against creatures made of shadow or from the shadow plane.

Avatar of War: While your sacred defense is active, you are immune to negative energy damage and when striking with a melee weapon you deal an additional 3d6 damage to creatures that are vulnerable to sunlight, made of shadow, or from the Shadow Plane.

BLESSINGS

Burning Light (Ex)

Prerequisite: 3rd level

When using fervor to channel positive energy to damage undead, increase the dice to 1d6 per 2 class levels you possess instead of four levels you possess after 2nd.

Dispersing the Darkness (Sp)

Prerequisite: 5th level

You can expend a use of fervor as an immediate action to counterspell or as a standard action to perform a targeted dispel (as dispel magic) against a spell with the darkness or shadow descriptors or shadow subschool.

Guiding Light (Su)

You constantly exude a light equivalent to a torch, though you can suppress or reactivate this light as a swift action.

At 7th level, you can expend a use of fervor to increase this light to a daylight spell effect for 10 minutes. At 11th level, when activating the daylight effect, it acts like true sunlight against creatures damaged by sunlight.

Flash of Sunlight (Sp)

As a standard action, you can create a flash of light in the eyes of a target, blinding it until the beginning of your next turn (Fortitude partial); they are dazzled for the same duration if they succeed on the save. Creatures with light blindness or light sensitivity take a penalty on the saving throw equal to 1/2 your class level.

This is a light effect and sightless creatures are unaffected by this ability.

Sun-Blessed Weapon (Su)

Prerequisite: 9th level

As a standard action, you can expend a use of fervor to grant a weapon you touch the flaming or undead–bane weapon special ability for 1 minute. You can expend two uses to have the weapon have the flaming burst weapon special ability or have both flaming and undead bane simultaneously.

Travel Domain

A warpriest with the travel domain is a free spirit, and a wanderer. Sometimes they fight to keep roads safe, sometimes they forge new paths, but they are always on the move.

Spells Available to Learn: All conjuration (teleportation) spells and non-polymorph spells that grant a new movement mode or an increase to your movement speed.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—longstrider, 2nd—air step , 3rd—litany of escape, 4th—dimension door, 5th—break enchantment, 6th—wind walk

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, while active you gain a bonus on Acrobatics checks and CMD of +1.

Avatar of War: While your sacred defense is active, you are treated as though under constant freedom of movement and fly spells at your caster level.

BLESSINGS

Blur of Battle (Ex)

You leverage increased movement for more effectiveness in combat. While you are under the effects of any spell that grants you a new movement mode or increase to your movement speed you may spend fervor to full attack as a standard action as long as you have moved at least 10 ft this turn.

Break Bonds (Su)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You cannot abide confinement. You may spend a fervor to affect any cage, shackle, or other object confining an intelligent creature within 30 feet as though by a knock spell using your caster level. This is a purely mental standard action, if a bond is successfully broken it appears to be due to some defect of construction or other failure and cannot be re-locked unless repaired.

Consummate Passenger (Su)

You can take advantage of another creature’s special movement. Whenever an adjacent creature uses a teleportation effect or is subject to a spell that causes them to move “such as levitate or telekinesis” you may spend fervor as an immediate action to follow them to their destination as though by the same effect and then you may make an attack of opportunity.

Great Strides (Ex)

You walk where you please. Your base land speed increases by 5 feet, this bonus increases by 5 feet for every 6 class levels you possess (to a maximum of 40 feet at 18th level).

In addition, you may spend fervor as a swift action to ignore difficult terrain for 1 minute.

Link Portal (Su)

Prerequisite: 11th level

You long to step from one favored city to another. You may spend 500 gp in supplies and spend ten minutes performing a ritual at a doorway, archway, or other clear marker of a portal. That portal is then charged with your magic, when you perform this ritual again at a second portal they become linked. You choose a password and anyone speaking the password can step into one portal and out the other regardless of distance. The two portals must be on the same plane. If you perform the ritual a third time you choose which portal to link to and the other ceases to be linked.

Trickery Domain

A warpriest with the trickery domain sees life for the game it can sometimes be. Deception and legerdemain are commonplace and natural in their eyes.

Spells Available to Learn: All illusion spells.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—obscure object; 2nd—compulsive liarPRG:UI, 3rd— nondetection, 4th—zone of silence; 5th—befuddled combatant, 6th—mislead

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, ranged attacks have a 10% chance to miss you. This effect can be overcome by true seeing and by creatures and attacks which do not rely on sight.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you become partially unreal. You take 50% damage from all sources but also only deal 50% damage to other creatures with your attacks. When you are damaged the source may make a Will save if it is a creature with a DC equal to 20 + your Wisdom modifier, if it succeeds it deals damage to you normally.

BLESSINGS

Forked Tongue (Su)

You are a master of twisting words and phrases to hide or exaggerate information as needed. You may spend fervor as part of the action of making a Bluff check, gaining a bonus on the roll equal to 1/2 your class level.

Hidden Threat (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 7th level

You can disguise your allies for deception or ambush. You may spend fervor as a standard action to affect any number of creatures within 30 feet with a disguise self spell at your caster level.

Sleight of Mind (Su)

Your illusions tend to stick in the minds of others. When a creature rolls a saving throw against an illusion spell you cast and that creature is within line of sight you may spend fervor as an immediate action to force them to roll twice and take the worse result.

Sudden Strike (Ex)

You leverage distractions in combat. When you deal weapon damage to an opponent that is flat-footed or otherwise denied their dexterity bonus to armor class you may spend fervor as a swift action to deal 1d6 additional precision damage + 1d6 for every 4 class levels.

Underhanded (Ex)

You have learned to take advantage of every opportunity in combat. You gain Combat Expertise and Improved Dirty Trick as bonus feats, and you ignore prerequisites other than Combat Expertise and Improved Dirty Trick when choosing feats that require Improved Dirty Trick as a prerequisite.

Vermin Domain

A warpriest with the Vermin domain sees the true value of creatures most consider pests.

They aspire to and admire the tenacity and cunning of such creatures.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells that allow you to summon vermin, transform into vermin, have a poison effect, or grant a fly, climb, or burrow speed.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—ant haul , 2nd—whip of spiders , 3rd—vomit swarm , 4th—insect plague, 5th—whip of ants, 6th—creeping doom

Sacred Defense: Each time you choose this sacred defense, you gain a +1 natural armor bonus to your AC.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, your body becomes a swarm of thousands of vermin. You gain the immunities of a swarm and can pass through spaces as though you were Fine-sized. You can still wield weapons, speak, and cast spells normally.

BLESSINGS

Compression (Su)

You can fit in much smaller places than expected, much like many vermin. You may squeeze through spaces as though you were two size categories smaller without penalty.

Redundant Anatomy (Ex)

To better emulate the vermin you admire you undergo a transformation that gives you extra protection against dire wounds. You gain a 25% chance to ignore precision damage and additional damage from critical hits. At 8th level, this becomes 50% and at 16th level it becomes 75%.

Swarming Escape (Su)

Prerequisite 7th level

You can briefly discorporate into a swarm of rats to escape danger. As a swift action, you may expend fervor to transform yourself and all equipment you are carrying into a swarm of rats until the beginning of your next turn.

In addition, you gain the benefits of an expeditious retreat spell while transformed. This is a polymorph effect.

Venomous Mien (Su)

Many vermin can be deadly to others and so can you.

Whenever you make a check to demoralize one or more targets you may also spend fervor as a free action to force them to save against a single poison you are carrying.

The poison is expended and the targets must make saves as though affected by it. When you make a check to demoralize multiple targets you must expend poison for each target separately. At 8th level, you may expend one additional fervor to increase the DC of the poison used by 2 for all targets.

Verminous Familiar (Su)

You gain a familiar, using your warpriest level as your wizard level to determine its abilities. You must choose one of the following as your familiar; any vermin plus the bat, lizard, rat, raven, squirrel, or viper.

Void Domain

A warpriest with the void domain is an agent of those dark unknowable deities from between the stars and is a violent vehicle for their inscrutable goals.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells that summon monsters, contact entities from other planes, affect gravity, void-related spells, those that affect aberrations, and those related to the stars and objects that come from space.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—feather fall, 2nd—contact entity I, 3rd—vengeful comets, 4th—eyes of the void, 5th—life bubble, 6th—planar binding

Sacred Defense: Each time you select this sacred defense you gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and a resistance to cold damage of 2.

Avatar of War: While your this ability is active, you constantly exude an aura of the void. Any creature within 10 feet takes cold damage equal to your Wisdom score and they cannot breathe and must hold their breath. Additionally, you do not need to breathe and your anatomy is constantly shifting, granting you 50% fortification.

BLESSINGS

Affect Gravity (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to grant yourself the effects of the levitate and spider climb spells for 1 minute. At 7th level, you can also fly as per the fly spell.

At 11th level, you gain the effects for 1 hour.

Call of the Void (Sp)

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to cast summon monster I, however you can only summon a single aberration or any creature with the entropic template.

At 3rd level and every two levels thereafter the spell level increases by 1 (to a maximum of summon monster IX at 17th level. Regardless of the spell level, you may still only summon a single aberration or entropic creature. The duration for this spell is 1 minute rather than the normal duration of the spell.

Gaze into the Void (Sp)

Prerequisites: 7th level

As a standard action you can expend fervor to cause all who gaze upon you to see the dark madness between the stars.

All creatures within 30 feet who can see you are confused for 1d4 rounds (Will negates). Creatures failing their save by 5 or more are confused for 2d4 rounds. You can maintain this connection to the void by spending a move action each round. This is a mind-affecting effect and relies on sight. Creatures without vision are unaffected, and others within the area may attempt to avert their eyes.

Shard of the Void (Sp)

You can expend fervor as a standard action to bring a small part of the void between the stars against your foes. You can either have it appear in a 5-foot square that deals 1d6 cold damage per 2 class levels you possess, or within a 30-foot cone or burst around you that deals damage equal to your fervor dice. A successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Wisdom modifier) halves the cold damage.

Void Acclimation (Ex)

You gain resistance to cold damage equal to your class level. If you already possess resistance to cold damage, the amount you resist is increased by this amount. Additionally, you can expend a use of fervor to no longer need to breathe for 1 round per class level. At 5th level, the duration is 1 minute/class level, and at 9th it is 1 hour per class level. You can choose to end this effect early as a free action.

War Domain

A warpriest that follows this domain is the most common warpriest. They revel in combat and skill at arms and fight wars in the name of their faith.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells that increase the damage of weapons, create weapons, increase attack rolls or damage rolls, increase Strength, and spells that create magical blades, combatants or other weapons.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—magic weapon, 2nd—spiritual weapon, 3rd—magic vestment, 4th—divine power, 5th—flame strike, 6th—blade barrier

Sacred Defense: Each time you select this sacred defense you gain a +1 bonus to your CMB and CMD.

Avatar of War: When activating this ability, you treat your base attack bonus as equal to your class level, you gain DR 10/-, and you can move at full speed regardless of your armor or encumbrance. Additionally, anytime you use fervor to cast a spell that improves your attack, Strength, or damage, as a swift action, you do not need to expend fervor.

BLESSINGS

Divine Challenge (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to challenge a visible foe within 30 feet. The target need not understand the challenge to be the target. You gain a +1 sacred bonus to your AC against them and a bonus equal to 1/2 your class level on CMB and Bluff checks to feint against them.

This challenge lasts for 1 minute or until the creature is defeated. At 7th level, the challenge lasts until the end of combat, and if the target creature surrenders but then initiates combat again within 1 minute, you can reinstate the challenge again without spending additional fervor.

You can only have one challenge active at a time.

Drawing Blood (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 9th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to grant a weapon you touch the wounding magic weapon property for 1 minute. This does not count against the weapon’s maximum enhancements or properties.

Martial Flexibility (Ex)

Prerequisites: 7th level

As a swift action you can expend fervor to gain the use of a combat feat for 1 minute. You must meet the prerequisites of the feat chosen. At 15th level, the duration increases to 1 hour.

Prepared for Combat (Su)

When rolling for initiative, you can expend fervor to allow you or an ally to reroll their initiative check and take the result of their choosing. You can expend 2 uses of fervor to grant the target a bonus to initiative checks equal to 1/2 your class level.

War Fervor (Su)

You expend a use of fervor as a standard action and touch an ally, granting it a tactical understanding of the battlefield for 1 minute. At the start of their turn, the target can choose from one of the following benefits: +10 feet to base land speed, +1 dodge bonus to AC, +1 insight bonus to attack rolls, or a +1 luck bonus to saving throws. The benefit lasts until the beginning of their next turn when they choose another, or the same, benefit, or the duration expires.

Water Domain

A warpriest that follows this domain brings the raging power of the sea into combat, dashing all that would stand in the way of their faith against the rocks.

Spells Available to Learn: Spells with the water descriptor.

Spontaneous Spells: 1st—hydraulic push, 2nd—fog cloud, 3rd—aqueous orbPRG:B2, 4th—heavy waterPPC:MM, 5th—tidal surgePRG:UW, 6th—fluid form

Sacred Defense: Each time you select this sacred defense you gain a 2 resistance to fire damage and a +2 bonus to saving throws to hold your breath.

Avatar of War: While your sacred defense is active, you are transformed into living water. When in water, you are invisible and gain a swim speed of 120 ft. In or out of water, you are immune to critical hits and precision damage and have DR 10/slashing. Additionally, your attacks can flow around your target’s defenses allowing you to make melee attacks against the target’s touch AC.

BLESSINGS

Aqueous Vision (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a swift action to be able to see through fog, precipitation, and water as though it were not there. Your attacks ignore concealment caused by water and you do you take penalties on Perception checks when looking through water. This includes water effects created by magic. This effect lasts for 1 minute. At 7th level this becomes 10 minutes, and at 13th level it becomes 1 hour.

Body of Water (Su)

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to gain the ability to breathe underwater and a swim speed equal to your base speed. If your base speed increases for any reason, so does the swim speed. This effect lasts for 1 minute. At 7th level this becomes 10 minutes, and at 13th level it becomes 1 hour.

Churning Waters (Su)

Prerequisite(s): 7th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to create magical waters then shift the positions of creatures around you. You may make a reposition or bull rush combat maneuver against 1 creature per 3 levels that are within 30 feet of you. For this combat maneuver, you use your class level instead of your base attack and your Wisdom modifier instead of Strength.

Drawing Water (Sp)

Prerequisites: 9th level

You can expend a use of fervor as a standard action to begin drawing moisture from nearby creatures. You pick one living target or target made of water within 30 feet and they take 1d6 damage per 2 class levels you possess, a successful Fortitude save halves this damage. If the target is made of water or is a water elemental, they take double damage and normal damage on a successful save.

The water gathers in a churning sphere above you. Each round you may use a standard action to draw more water, either form the same creature or another qualifying target within range. For every 30 damage you deal in this way, the sphere gains 1 gallon of water, as it pulls from the moisture around the target as well as the target itself. You can continue to draw water for a number of rounds equal to your class level. If you choose to end the effect or that duration expires, you can direct the water into a container or allow it to splash on the ground.

Water Blast (Su)

You expend a use of fervor as a standard action to make a ranged touch attack with a blast of water against a target within 60 feet. If the attack hits it deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage per two class levels you possess.

This bludgeoning damage is considered magical and either cold iron or silver for DR purposes. At 11th level, the damage is also considered adamantine. The blast also douses any non-magical fires of small size or smaller.
